body.title: Add SecurityLocator interface extending Locator
body.summary: Add `SecurityLocator` as a plain TS interface extending the framework's `Locator` (src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts:271-274) with trustBoundaryId and taintPathStepIndex as first-class optional fields, following the open-Locator-kind extensibility pattern. No change to Locator or Pointer themselves -- a security-graph citation is represented as Pointer{path, section: SecurityLocator, contentHash?}, reusing Pointer unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: SecurityLocator structurally extends Locator -- kind and value fields present plus trustBoundaryId and taintPathStepIndex
A SecurityLocator instance is assignable to Pointer.section with no change to Pointer's own type

tests.name: SecurityLocator structural extension of Locator/Pointer (trust-boundary id + taint-path step index fields)
